2026-06-08 — Post-v1.1.0 maintenance session. All prior-handoff NEXT items CLEARED.

DONE THIS SESSION:
- HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN ROTATED + verified (new fine-grained PAT, contents:write scoped to seabearDEV/homebrew-reverie; secret Updated 2026-06-08T20:03Z). The expired-PAT root cause from the last handoff is RESOLVED — the release workflow's tap step self-serves again. Caveat: fine-grained PATs still expire ≤1yr, so this recurs annually until the deploy-key fix lands → filed as #123.
- Smoke-tested the published stable 1.1.0 binary: `rvr --version`→1.1.0; `rvr --json get` envelope well-formed; MCP `rvr mcp-server` initialize+tools/list returns all 19 tools. PASS.
- Store hygiene (dogfooded seedDensity): pruned/compressed historical project.* (~35KB→~21KB), removed project.{v115Hints,bunValidate,v112}, compressed project.{v114Plan,v112patches,bunMigrationScope,releasePlan}, rewrote project.inFlight current+lean (was stale at 1.0.0). Added AGENTS.md via `rvr init` (this repo wasn't dogfooding the WS2 file). Net: size-budget shedder now drops 1 context entry vs 8 — more seeds survive bootstrap.
- Issues filed: #121 (CLAUDE.md template is MCP-only → CLI-ban cohort gets wrong instructions; correctness-bug follow-up to #117 WS2), #122 (project.* exempt from size-budget shedding → route through #84), #123 (deploy-key to end PAT rotation). Added an `archived` lifecycle-state spec as a comment on #84 (chosen over an _archive/ folder — git + docs/ are the history layer; archived entries stay addressable but off the bootstrap hot path).

NEXT (no urgent items): WS3 #119 when ready; v1.15 search theme (#13/#43, user-flagged); #84 entry-health design (now carries the archived-state spec). Optionally implement #121 + regenerate this repo's MCP-only CLAUDE.md once the template is surface-aware.
